references.text: God's original instruction to place the table on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil, which Moses now carries out in Exodus 40:22.
The description of the table for showbread that God commanded Moses to make, and which is now placed in the tabernacle.
Bezalel makes the table according to God's instructions, the same table that Moses now sets in place.
The showbread that was to lie on the table in the tabernacle, arranged in two rows.
Instructions on how the table was to be covered when the tabernacle was moved.
Solomon makes a gold table for the showbread in the temple, replacing the tabernacle's table.
The Epistle to the Hebrews describes the first tent with its lampstand and the table with the showbread, referring to the furnishings of the tabernacle.
